name: Ravnica
description: Ravnica is a plane with a worldwide cityscape of grand halls, slums and ancient ruins, where ten guilds vie for power under the Guildpact.

summary.text: Ravnica is a plane with a worldwide cityscape of grand halls, slums and ancient ruins, where ten guilds vie for power under the Guildpact.

bio.text: Ravnica is the home plane of Jace and Vraska, and the plane where their paths first crossed, with Vraska once trying to kill Jace there.

citations.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.
"Vraska". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Azor built its guild system and then left, and Jace later admitted he had not upheld his duties as Guildpact.

citations.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citations.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

bio.text: Jace saw that Ravnica was Bolas's goal, and Vraska realized Bolas wanted her help to unleash an army on it.

citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.
"Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

bio.text: Nicol Bolas then invaded the plane with the Dreadhorde.

citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

bio.text: Its profile says that as the Guildpact dissolves through a mysterious outside threat, Ravnica descends into a cold war between the guilds.

citations.text: "Ravnica". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: In the Murders at Karlov Manor story Proft deduced, and Niv-Mizzet confirmed, that Niv-Mizzet plans to make Ravnica the hub of the connected Multiverse.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

status.text: The material does not give a final fate for Ravnica; its latest events show it as a guild-ruled plane in a cold war between the guilds, with Niv-Mizzet planning to make it the hub of the connected Multiverse.

citations.text: "Ravnica". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Maree suggests tracking Jace's long disappearances and Ral is appointed Head Researcher of Project Lightning Bug.
timeline.quote: Thus Ral had been appointed Head Researcher of a project to record and explain Beleren's disappearances.

citation.work: Project Lightning Bug
citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Gideon and Dars watch Foundry Street burn in a goblin gang war that began with Dargig's murder.
timeline.quote: It was the Shattergang way of declaring war.

citation.work: Limits
citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon brings the captured Krenko, stabbed twice in the leg, to the Boros garrison.
timeline.quote: "And I come bearing gifts," said Gideon

citation.work: Limits
citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: A canister lands in the garrison with a note from the Shattergang Brothers threatening Boros territory unless Krenko is handed over.
timeline.quote: Turn him over to us, or we will reduce Boros territory to rubble.

citation.work: Limits
citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon storms the Shattergang hideout, fights Rikkig and survives his bomb; Rikkig escapes while Gideon and Dars free prisoners.
timeline.quote: "The Boros didn't take Krenko. I did. Just like I got your brother. And now I'm here for you."

citation.work: Limits
citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace is surprised to see Liliana knocking at his secret door via the teleportal, and uses an illusion to greet her.
timeline.quote: Jace hadn't seen Liliana Vess since the day he'd realized she was playing him

citation.work: Catching Up
citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana enters, and Jace refuses to trust her after she betrayed him; she reveals she had a spy killed to find him.
timeline.quote: "Nothing you can say will make me trust you," he said. "Not after you betrayed me."

citation.work: Catching Up
citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana explains she is killing her demonic creditors, with two down, and describes the Chain Veil and how Garruk is becoming a monster.
timeline.quote: "Two down," she said, holding up two fingers and grinning. "Two to go."

citation.work: Catching Up
citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she hoped they could start over, and Jace plays along, agreeing to dinner.
timeline.quote: I guess I was hoping we could … start over.

citation.work: Catching Up
citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana storms out when Jace agrees to go with Gideon, refusing his invitation to come along.
timeline.quote: "You're out of your mind," she said. "I've got demons to kill."

citation.work: Catching Up
citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace agrees to help Gideon, insisting he rest first, and takes him to a healer.
timeline.quote: "Fine," Gideon said at last. "Take me to this healer."

citation.work: Catching Up
citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon recruits Jace on Ravnica but not Liliana or Chandra, and the two return to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Together, Gideon and Jace returned to Zendikar to face the threat of the Eldrazi.

citation.work: Battle for Zendikar Story Summary
citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Chandra hiding in an alley and persuades her to come along shopping.
timeline.quote: She was crouched halfway down an alley three blocks from Jace's home

citation.work: Homesick
citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana invites Chandra to join her and talk on the way.
timeline.quote: Then I suppose you'll have to come along and see.

citation.work: Homesick
citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa feels overwhelmed and alone among the crowds of Ravnica, cut off from Zendikar's voice.
timeline.quote: She'd never been among so many, and never been so alone.

citation.work: Homesick
citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek privately meets Jace at a Rakdos show to tell him about an irregular planeswalk.
timeline.quote: An irregular planeswalk.

citation.work: In This Very Arena
citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ral explains that Vraska left Ravnica for no destination, as if into a void, and has not been seen since.
timeline.quote: She didn't planeswalk to a plane. Only from one.

citation.work: In This Very Arena
citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ral reveals he can still detect when Jace leaves Ravnica, and chides him for leaving the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: First to Zendikar, then off to Innistrad, was it?

citation.work: In This Very Arena
citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ral warns Jace that others would love his position and to make more effort.
timeline.quote: Just remember there are those who'd love to be in the position you've blundered your way into.

citation.work: In This Very Arena
citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana appears and tells Jace that Tezzeret is alive and well on Kaladesh.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret. Alive and well.

citation.work: In This Very Arena
citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana demands that Jace come to Kaladesh and bring the muscle, then planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Come to Kaladesh. Bring the muscle.

citation.work: In This Very Arena
citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace abandons Ral and goes to fetch Gideon.
timeline.quote: dodged down an alleyway to fetch Gideon.

citation.work: In This Very Arena
citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls working for Bolas and turning Jace against Tezzeret, and Jace wrecking Tezzeret's mind on Ravnica four years ago.
timeline.quote: Jace had wrecked Tezzeret's mind and left him for dead on some remote plane.

citation.work: Puppets
citation.text: "Puppets" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: In a memory, Mazirek and Vraska share tea and talk of leadership and pride.
timeline.quote: If I am to be met with disrespect, then I must first love myself with a fierceness no fool can take away.

citation.work: Pride of the Kraul
citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Mazirek recalls meeting Vraska while consulting the Ochran assassins, and their friendship since.
timeline.quote: Mazirek trusted Vraska with his life.

citation.work: Pride of the Kraul
citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: In a memory, Mazirek rages that Jarad has cut the kraul's food and ignored them, and Vraska suggests change without bloodshed.
timeline.quote: There are plenty of ways to enact change without shedding blood.

citation.work: Pride of the Kraul
citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace about Ravnica, and he conjures an illusion of the snowy city, which she admires with homesickness.
timeline.quote: Yes. This is Ravnica.

citation.work: Something Else Entirely
citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska is struck by a vision of Ravnica from Jace's mind while swimming.
timeline.quote: Vraska was still in Ixalan, but the image in her mind was of Ravnica.

citation.work: The Race, Part 2
citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees a memory of a teenage Jace getting white tattoos from a Gruul shaman on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: The shaman leaned over the teenager and drew a line with his finger down Jace's cheek, leaving a brilliant white tattoo in its place.

citation.work: The Flood
citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace's memory shows Vraska as a menacing figure the first time they met.
timeline.quote: It was the first time they had met.

citation.work: The Flood
citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska apologizes for trying to kill Jace on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: I'm sorry I tried to kill you on Ravnica,

citation.work: The Flood
citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor admits he left Ravnica when he finished and Jace admits he has not upheld his duties as Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Because Ravnica was one of many, and I left when I was finished.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace saw that Ravnica was Bolas's goal.
timeline.quote: Ravnica was writ large upon the ambition in Nicol Bolas's mind.

citation.work: Sabotage
citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska realizes Bolas wants her help to unleash an army on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: He wants to unleash an army.

citation.work: Sabotage
citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska returns to her chamber on Ravnica after the portal closes.
timeline.quote: she was standing back in her own chamber on Ravnica.

citation.work: Wool Over the Eyes
citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska finds Bolas's letter summoning her to the meditation plane.
timeline.quote: MEDITATION PLANE

citation.work: Wool Over the Eyes
citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska feels uneasy that she may be missing something.
timeline.quote: She felt unsettled, though she could not remember anything that might be missing . . . or why.

citation.work: Wool Over the Eyes
citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas's note names her guildleader and gives a location for Jarad.
timeline.quote: HE IS ALONE AND IMPRISONED HERE

citation.work: Wool Over the Eyes
citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska prepares to petrify Jarad.
timeline.quote: and contemplated what she ought to say to Jarad before she petrified him.

citation.work: Wool Over the Eyes
citation.text: "Wool Over the Eyes" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Merret, working the docks as a Dimir agent, nearly pockets a bottle of expensive whiskey from a crate before his boss approaches and he hides it.
timeline.quote: Sloppy, Merret, sloppy.

citation.work: Under the Cover of Fog
citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Grimbly Wothis orders Merret to clear the fog from the harbor for an investor, threatening to dock his pay.
timeline.quote: How's this for confidence . . . you don't clear it and you don't get your pay for today?

citation.work: Under the Cover of Fog
citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Merret barely thins the fog and reveals a Simic schooner cloaking itself, which Wothis uses as a selling point to the investor.
timeline.quote: Fog swirls, barely, clearing about halfway to the other side of the river

citation.work: Under the Cover of Fog
citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Failing to steal from a posh grocer, Merret breaks into Grimbly Wothis's apartment through an unlocked window.
timeline.quote: I round the building, make a quick hop to the balcony, and sure enough, find an unlocked window.

citation.work: Under the Cover of Fog
citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Merret takes a loaf of bread and drinks drops of an Elixir of Focus from Wothis's kitchen.
timeline.quote: Just one more, for good measure.

citation.work: Under the Cover of Fog
citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Wothis's wife enters the kitchen, and the elixir sharpens Merret's magic enough to make himself invisible to her.
timeline.quote: I draw on magic, and her mind opens up to me like a map.

citation.work: Under the Cover of Fog
citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Empowered, Merret clears the whole harbor, then in a show-off moment casts a nightmare on the crane operator Yantis, dropping a crate of whiskey toward Wothis and the investor.
timeline.quote: Yantis screams, fighting all the terrifying nothings in front of him.

citation.work: Under the Cover of Fog
citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Wothis shoves the investor into the river and jumps in as the crate smashes; Merret fears House Dimir will erase him.
timeline.quote: Nope, there's nothing covert about ruining a thousand zinos worth of cargo.

citation.work: Under the Cover of Fog
citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Leighbet demands a promotion from Master Dax, is fired and loses her access and title, and starts an unsanctioned lab in the boilerpit beneath her apartment.
timeline.quote: that just leaves you standing at the front steps of the Lightning Rod, a box full of your desk belongings in your arms.

citation.work: Testing the Dark Waters
citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Leighbet hires Tamsyn Sweene as a blastseeker, who claims past experience and passes a practical test.
timeline.quote: Tamsyn Sweene. Call me Tammy, and we've got a problem.

citation.work: Testing the Dark Waters
citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Their serum, made from rift plant samples, makes a lab mouse completely impervious to electricity.
timeline.quote: It's completely impervious to electricity.

citation.work: Testing the Dark Waters
citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn tells a false story of her chemister's death and talks Leighbet into hiring her by promising to get the lab approved without sanctions.
timeline.quote: I can get your lab declared an Innovative Niche Workshop.

citation.work: Testing the Dark Waters
citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn gets the lab officially recognized by the Izmundi and recruits five paid test subjects, and the serum protects all of them from electric shocks.
timeline.quote: The other four tests go exactly the same, successes all around.

citation.work: Testing the Dark Waters
citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn convinces Leighbet that the test subjects must be silenced and poisons all five with a lethal sleep elixir, and Leighbet goes along with it.
timeline.quote: I already gave them all a hyper-concentrated dose of sleep elixir laced with an ethereal death accelerant.

citation.work: Testing the Dark Waters
citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Desperate for money, Leighbet signs up for paid experiments and is transformed by Simic biomancers into a clawed, fanged monster, then flees into the sewers.
timeline.quote: my teeth are reshuffling, becoming jagged and ragged like a mouthful of fangs.

citation.work: Testing the Dark Waters
citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Bozak, harvesting rare mushrooms on the family farmstead, hears the undercity news that a new lich seeks an apprentice skilled at mushroom identification.
timeline.quote: the lich is seeking an apprentice with a proficiency in mushroom identification and a keen interest in necromancy.

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Bozak explains why he wants to be a necromancer and sneaks away from his siblings and Mother's carapace to enter the contest.
timeline.quote: I pack my maps, my journals, my vials, and my harvester's satchel and sneak away while my siblings lie dreaming.

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: The lich starts a contest for twenty-six competitors to retrieve four of the most dangerous mushrooms in Ravnica, handing out maps.
timeline.quote: Only one of you will be deemed skillful enough to serve as my apprentice,

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Zegodonis bumps Bozak and tears his map; Bozak then spots woodwraiths in the mangrove and warns a few others, who escape while the rest are killed.
timeline.quote: We hear the creaking of old branches and the suck of roots pulling up from waterlogged soil.

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Bozak meets the kraul Limin and the gorgon Kata, collects zombie fungus, and makes a temporary truce with Limin.
timeline.quote: If we share information and resources, we can all but guarantee a kraul will win.

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: An elf competitor punctures his zombie fungus, is overtaken by spores and climbs a tree to die as a host.
timeline.quote: The elf chooses a tree and scales it like his body had been built for this sole purpose.

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Bozak collects devouring angel mushrooms from a mossdog den while Limin spreads his scent; Limin throws a rock and wakes the dogs and flies off.
timeline.quote: tossing a rock into the mossdog den

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Bozak and Kata team up against the mossdogs; Kata petrifies them but also kills nearly a hundred of Bozak's locusts.
timeline.quote: The third mossdog turns into a statue, and with it, nearly a hundred locusts.

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Kata tries to petrify Bozak, and he stabs her in the stomach with his staff carved from Mother's leg.
timeline.quote: I move fast, thrust the staff forward. It catches the gorgon in the stomach.

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Riding a deadbridge goliath, Bozak races back while the surviving Zegodonis ambushes Limin and steals his satchel; Bozak reaches the lich first.
timeline.quote: He batters Limin as he passes, breaking off two legs and part of a wing.

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: The lich declares both Bozak and Zegodonis his apprentices, though he favors Zegodonis.
timeline.quote: And both of you shall serve under me.

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Months later Bozak tends zombies and learns that Boros officers have been exposed to zombie fungus, and Vraska fears Boros will use it to infiltrate the undercity.
timeline.quote: Three high-ranking Boros officers were exposed to the same type of zombie fungus we had been asked to gather.

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Alone in the lich's sanctum, Bozak tries a death spell for the first time on a rat corpse.
timeline.quote: I practice the movements I've seen the lich do

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Hiding in a nook, Bozak overhears the lich telling Boros soldiers that he planted a devouring angel mushroom on Vraska's gown to frame her for the Tin Street massacre.
timeline.quote: Boros will have no choice but to charge Vraska with murder.

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: The lich reveals he hopes Boros will back a Devkarin successor as guildmaster, and the soldiers hint Zegodonis is their pick.
timeline.quote: they take into consideration the help I've been to you today.

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Bozak reanimates the rat for the first time and uses it to bite the lich, creating a distraction so he can flee to warn Vraska.
timeline.quote: then takes a chomp on the lich's ankle.

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Bozak survives the fall but wakes controlled by the fungus, with Mazirek tending him, and willingly submits to serve him.
timeline.quote: ready and willing to serve him as best I can

citation.work: Death's Precious Moments
citation.text: "Death's Precious Moments" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Ambrellin tells Terrik to forgive himself, and he hides a wurm under his bed while telling her the neighbors' wurm sightings are over-meditation.
timeline.quote: do you really think I'd be able to fit a half-grown wurm under my bed?

citation.work: Bound and Bonded
citation.text: "Bound and Bonded" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Terrik uses bramble seeds to stop an Orzhov thug trying to sell him insurance, then reaches the orphanage near the ruined basilica.
timeline.quote: thorny vines erupt from the sidewalk, entangling my pursuer in their scratchy embrace.

citation.work: Bound and Bonded
citation.text: "Bound and Bonded" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Nov 2018.

timeline.summary: Bazda steals Terrik's shears and follows him home to the Selesnyan cooperative.
timeline.quote: It's only fair I hold something valuable of yours.
